item.title: Rajasthan Intelligence Arrests ISI Agent in Jaisalmer for Espionage
item.description: JAISALMER: Rajasthan Intelligence on Friday arrested a suspected Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) agent from Pokhran in Jaisalmer district for allegedly sharing sensitive information related to the Indian Army with Pakistani handlers. According to Prafull Kumar, Additional Director General of Police (Intelligence), espionage activities by Pakistani intelligence agencies in Rajasthan are under continuous surveillance. item.title: MHA Cracks Down on ‘Wingo’ App, Blocks Servers and Social Media Promotion
item.description: NEW DELHI: Officials on Friday said the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has blocked command-and-control servers linked to the ‘Wingo’ app network to disrupt its operations, describing it as a “telecom mule as a service” platform that lured users with earnings through SMS-based tasks. item.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulates locals as Patna Bird Sanctuary, Chhari-Dhand become Ramsar Sites
item.description: NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday welcomed the inclusion of Patna Bird Sanctuary in Uttar Pradesh’s Etah and Chhari-Dhand in Gujarat as Ramsar sites. These are wetlands deemed to be of “international importance” under the Ramsar Convention. item.title: India’s forex reserves hit record high of $709.4 billion
item.description: NEW DELHI: India’s foreign exchange reserves reached a new all-time high in the week ended January 23, according to the Reserve Bank of India’s latest data. item.description: SRINAGAR: The night temperature settled below the freezing point across Kashmir, but rose in most areas, officials said, as Saturday marks the beginning of ‘Chillai Khurd’ and end of the harshest winter period.
